Grain: The query returns one row per qualifying superhero-attribute-power combination; since each superhero has at most one Speed attribute and the Intelligence power is a single condition, duplicates are not expected for the requested output.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1."XCL_025" = T2."XCL_016"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN superpower AS T5 ON T4."XCL_013" = T5."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T6 ON T1."XCL_018" = T6."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T7 ON T6."XCL_010" = T7."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_017" <> 'Human'
AND T3."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
AND T5."XCL_031" = 'Intelligence'
AND T7."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
AND T6."XCL_011" > (SELECT MIN(ha."XCL_011") FROM hero_attribute AS ha INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003" WHERE a."XCL_004" = 'Speed')

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s.XCL_019 || ' ' || s.XCL_020 AS full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
JOIN race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
WHERE sp.XCL_031 = 'Intelligence'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
  AND r.XCL_017 != 'Human'
  AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND ha.XCL_011 > (
      SELECT MIN(ha2.XCL_011)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
      WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
  )
